name: Canillas de Albaida (Spain)
description: Green field with a yellow band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Canillas de Albaida (a bend and plants on white).
history: Municipal flag of Canillas de Albaida; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: band from the upper hoist to the lower fly
